name: Load rejection from 50 percent load
description: Unit is started, brought to rated speed and loaded to 50 %. The generator breaker then opens and the whole load is lost at once. The governor must catch the speed surge.

criteria.text: Speed is within 3450-3550 RPM just before the load is lost
Peak speed stays below the 3850 RPM overspeed trip level
Speed returns to 3450-3550 RPM within 30 s of the load loss and holds for 10 s
Exhaust gas temperature stays below the 620 degC trip level

negative_tests.text: With the governor removed the rotor is left with the fuel it had at 50 % load and runs away until the overspeed protection trips it.
